sources.name: repo-markdown
sources.extraction: all *.md tracked under the repo, sorted by path, excluding data/corpus and the transient directories ['.eggs', '.git', '.mypy_cache', '.pytest_cache', '.ruff_cache', '.tox', '.venv', '__pycache__', 'build', 'dist', 'node_modules', 'site-packages', 'venv'] (whose contents depend on whether the tests have been run); fenced+inline code, URLs, table rows and emphasis/link markup stripped (strip_markdown), then normalized onto the charset

sources.name: repo-latex
sources.extraction: all *.tex tracked under the repo, sorted by path, excluding the transient directories listed for repo-markdown; comments, math/tabular/figure environments and control sequences stripped (strip_latex), then normalized

sources.name: python-stdlib
sources.extraction: all *.py under the CPython stdlib root excluding site-packages/ and test directories, sorted by path; docstrings and comments stripped (strip_python, so the prose inside code lands in the prose register, not here), then normalized

sources.name: man-pages-man1+man8
sources.extraction: gzipped man pages in man1/man8, sorted by name; roff comments, metadata requests and font/size escapes stripped (strip_roff) while prose-bearing request arguments are kept, then normalized

sources.name: iweb-anchor
sources.extraction: NOT REPRODUCIBLE — consumed as committed derived counts. The iWeb corpus (Davies 2018) is licensed and non-redistributable and no extraction script was ever committed, so these counts cannot be regenerated from source text. Their identity is pinned by the sha256 below; their derivation is unverifiable. Skipgrams re-derived from trigrams.txt by marginalization for consistency.
